module.name: holoscan-isp
module.description: A GPU image signal processor for raw camera frames: Bayer mosaics of any pattern, 8 to 16 bits or packed MIPI RAW10/RAW12, through black level, lens shading, white balance (manual, gray world or white patch), bilinear or Malvar-He-Cutler demosaic, sharpening, a colour matrix and a tone curve to display-ready RGB, with histograms, mean levels and an auto-exposure suggestion. CUDA kernels, with a bit-exact CPU backend.

hardware.name: NVIDIA GPU
hardware.description: A CUDA-capable GPU supported by the Holoscan SDK, for the cuda backend. The cpu backend runs without one.
